financial_question: Can target-market opening-call-auction state explain a further part of the CSI1000 next-session opening gap while remaining causal and operationally distinct from simply reading the final opening price?

SSE.level1_finding: Official SSE Level-1 semantics are sufficient for the early-auction measurement family: during call auction the quotation publishes the virtual opening/reference price, virtual matched quantity and virtual unmatched quantity/direction. Historical Level-1 Snapshot.csv includes call-auction state.

level2_schema_switch.before_2018_12_24: Level-2 opening call-auction state is carried by sh2\yyyymmdd\Auction.csv with SecurityID, DateTime, Price, VirtualAuctionQty, LeaveQty and Side.
level2_schema_switch.from_2018_12_24: Level-2 opening-auction state is published through sh2\yyyymmdd\Snapshot.csv.

SSE.correction_to_v1_0: Level-2 is not a scientific hard requirement. A validated historical Level-1 or Level-2 snapshot transport is acceptable if it reproduces the required pre-09:20 state with official semantics.
SSE.access_status: Official historical products are licensed/application products; no anonymous reproducible full-coverage 2015-2020 transport has yet been established.

SZSE.finding: Official quotation semantics encode call-auction reference price, matched quantity and unmatched quantity through Level-1 quotation fields, so Level-1 is sufficient for the same early-auction measurement family.
SZSE.access_status: Historical Tick Data is distributed through licensed/application channels; no anonymous reproducible full-coverage 2015-2020 transport has yet been established.

exchange_rule_semantics.cancel_rule: orders may be cancelled during 09:15-09:20; cancellation requests are not accepted during 09:20-09:25

causal_clock_preanalysis.reason: latest conceptual point before the non-cancellable 09:20-09:25 phase begins; measures early auction consensus/imbalance while preserving an operational distinction from the final opening result
causal_clock_preanalysis.secondary_later_cutoffs: not selectable in the first experiment; 09:20+ or near-09:25 snapshots require a separately preregistered execution-use case
causal_clock_preanalysis.reason_09_25_forbidden: the final call-auction price is economically almost the object being predicted and would turn explanatory power into target reconstruction

alternative_transport_audit.JoinQuant: authentication required; exact full 2015-2020 pre-09:20 snapshot history and frozen transport contract not proven
alternative_transport_audit.Tushare_stk_auction_o: final/result-level opening-auction aggregate rather than the frozen early 09:19:59 state; unsuitable
alternative_transport_audit.AKShare_Eastmoney_pre_minute: pre-open minute surface is recent-day only, not a 2015-2020 historical transport
alternative_transport_audit.TongdaXin_eltdx: current-day auction access exists but no proven full historical pre-09:20 series
alternative_transport_audit.KLineAPI: historical auction surface is final/09:25 oriented and not a validated early-state source
alternative_transport_audit.Caifushuju: paid reseller claims historical auction tick data but official provenance/full schema closure has not been established for this branch
alternative_transport_audit.HuggingFace_Wind_L2_mirror: starts in 2017, downloadable mirror is partial/gated, and therefore cannot be the sole 2015-2020 frozen source
alternative_transport_audit.repo_1m_official: contains no pre-09:20 historical state and using post-open bars would leak/reconstruct the target

candidate_information_families_if_histor.note: Economic measurement families only; formulas and multiplicity must be frozen after transport and point-in-time membership are audited.
families: point-in-time CSI1000 aggregate virtual-reference-price gap versus previous close
matched-quantity intensity normalized by lagged liquid capacity
breadth of component-level positive/negative virtual gaps
candidate_information_families_if_histor.component_membership: must use point-in-time CSI1000 constituents available for the target date; current constituents applied retroactively are forbidden
candidate_information_families_if_histor.weights: official point-in-time weights are preferred for index-like aggregation; breadth/dispersion/equal-member summaries may be preregistered as non-hindsight alternatives if exact weights are not reproducibly available

hard_data_gates_before_any_model: document exact accepted historical Level-1-or-Level-2 schema and source identifiers for both exchanges
establish reproducible 2015-2020 transport coverage for 09:15:00-09:19:59 state
prove timestamps and auction-state field semantics for both exchanges
prove point-in-time CSI1000 constituents and, for weighted features, point-in-time weights; otherwise preregister a non-hindsight aggregation that does not require unavailable weights
zero selectable rows at or after 09:20:00 in the first experiment
no use of final opening auction price as an explanatory feature

correction_note.reason: Version 1.0 overstated Level-2 as the necessary historical product. Official Level-1 interface semantics show that the required virtual reference price, matched quantity and unmatched quantity state can be represented in Level-1 call-auction snapshots as well.
